I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). These two posts share one paper, and two-thirds of it is a B.Com accounting exam. If you are a commerce graduate, this is where your degree counts most.

PSSSB Advertisement No. 05 of 2023 (Group-B, 157 posts in 11 post types) was published on 23 August 2023; applications ran from 30 August to 27 September 2023, fee by 29 September 2023. This page uses that advertisement and the board's official plan of written examination for Senior Assistant (Accounts) and Junior Auditor.

Latest notification

Advt 05/2023 had:

  • Senior Assistant (Accounts): 2 posts in Punjab State Lotteries (General 1, SC Mazhbi & Balmiki 1).
  • Junior Auditor: 60 posts in the Finance Department (Local Fund Accounts) - General 25, SC Mazhbi & Balmiki 7, SC Ramdasia & others 5, BC 5, ex-servicemen 8 (General 4, SC M&B 2, SC R&O 1, BC 1), sportspersons 2, hearing-impaired 2, EWS 6.

No newer advertisement for these posts is in our archive yet. PPSC's Junior Auditor is a different recruitment - see our PPSC Junior Auditor guide.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the exam pattern?

Under the official Advt 05/2023 plan - 120 MCQs, 120 marks, 2 hours. Part A has 40 general questions and Part B has 80 accounting questions, with 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.

Which subjects are in the accounting part?

Financial accounting (including partnership, consignment, joint venture and Tally ERP 9), corporate accounting under the Companies Act 2013, management accounting (ratios, fund flow, cash flow) and cost accounting (materials, labour, overheads, CVP, marginal costing, budgeting, standard costing).

Is this the same as PPSC Junior Auditor?

No. PPSC recruits its own Junior Auditor (Group-B) through a separate exam. This page is for the PSSSB posts in Advt 05/2023.

When were these posts last advertised?

In PSSSB Advertisement No. 05 of 2023. Its eligibility, pay and post numbers are on this page.
